summary: Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing all three. Iran conducted multiple missile and UAV launches from Khuzestan and Isfahan provinces, while an Israeli drone exploded in southern Lebanon. Former U.S. President Trump threatened renewed strikes on Iran after January 1.
key_points: Israeli military confirms strike on three PIJ operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing three. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)
Iran launched a missile from Haftkel, Khuzestan, and two missiles from 15 Khordad Garrison, Isfahan. (Source: @shin_persian/12740, @shin_persian/12745)
UAV launched from 5th Fighter Base, Omidiyeh, Khuzestan; another UAV crashed in Khoy, West Azerbaijan. (Source: @shin_persian/12748, @shin_persian/12736)
Israeli drone exploded in field near residential cooperative in Shukin, Nabatieh district, Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/54479)
Explosions reported in Zoutar Al-Sharqiya and Adshit Al-Qasir in Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/54460, @redlinkleb/54501)
IDF Chief of Staff says military needs increased force levels for expanded operational challenges across all arenas. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)
Trump states inclination to restart strikes on Iran after Jan 1, warns Iranian ships breaking blockade will be sunk. (Source: @amitsegal/67451)
UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter observed heading toward northern occupied Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/54497)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces struck three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood, killing all three. Iran conducted multiple missile and UAV launches from Khuzestan and Isfahan provinces, while an Israeli drone exploded in southern Lebanon. Former U.S. President Trump threatened renewed strikes on Iran after January 1.

points: A UAV crashed near Khoy in West Azerbaijan Province at 1246Z, indicating possible operational failure or interception in northwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12736)
A missile was launched from Haftkel in Khuzestan Province at 19:43 local time, demonstrating continued missile readiness in southwestern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12740)

Jet activity was heard over Abadan, Khuzestan at 21:20 local time, and over Saqqez, Kurdistan Province at 18:36 local time, suggesting heightened air operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12744, @shin_persian/12738)
A UAV launched from the 5th Fighter Base at Omidiyeh, Khuzestan at 1845Z, marking a deliberate deployment from a known tactical aviation facility. (Source: @shin_persian/12748)
Two missiles launched from the 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan Province at 21:37 local time, indicating central Iran air defense or strategic missile activity. (Source: @shin_persian/12745)
Approximately 50 truck drivers joined a strike in Masjed Soleyman, Khuzestan, reflecting domestic labor unrest in a key oil-producing region. (Source: @shin_persian/12743)

The Israeli military conducted a strike in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood killing three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives it said were falsely presented as aid workers. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)

IDF Chief of Staff stated during a Southern Command exercise that the military monitors threats in all arenas and requires increased force levels to meet significantly expanded operational challenges. (Source: @amitsegal/67449)

Former U.S. President Trump told Fox News he is inclined to renew strikes on Iran after January 1 and warned Iranian ships attempting to break a blockade would find themselves at the bottom of the sea. (Source: @amitsegal/67451)
A UH-60 Black Hawk transport helicopter was observed moving toward northern occupied Palestine, suggesting troop or equipment movement toward the Lebanese border. (Source: @redlinkleb/54497)
A 16-year-old was moderately wounded in a violence incident in Al-Sayyid in the Negev, highlighting internal security tensions. (Source: @N12chat/236436)

Israeli airstrike in Tel al-Hawa, Gaza City killed three Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives whom the military said were falsely presented as aid workers, according to Palestinian media. (Source: @manniefabian/59570)
An Israeli drone exploded in a field near a residential cooperative in Shukin, Nabatieh district, with the incident mapped on live tracking channels. (Source: @redlinkleb/54479)
An alert was issued for a hostile drone explosion in Shukin town, confirming the same event as a security notification. (Source: @redlinkleb/54478)
An explosion was reported in Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, marked on live maps with an explosion symbol. (Source: @redlinkleb/54460)
An explosion was reported in Adshit Al-Qasir, also marked on live maps with an explosion symbol. (Source: @redlinkleb/54501)
UKMTO issued advisory 217-26 for maritime security in regional waters, indicating ongoing naval concerns in the Gulf or Red Sea. (Source: @shin_persian/12739)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous missile launches from Khuzestan and Isfahan, coupled with UAV operations from Omidiyeh and a crash in Khoy, suggest a coordinated readiness posture or live-fire exercise amid heightened tensions. Israeli strikes in Gaza and drone activity over southern Lebanon indicate continued kinetic operations against Iranian proxies. Trump's explicit threat to restart strikes on Iran after January 1 introduces a major escalatory variable that could trigger preemptive Iranian actions or proxy activation across the region.
sections.regional_response: Lebanese monitoring channels are actively mapping drone explosions in Nabatieh, signaling local surveillance of Israeli air incursions. The UKMTO maritime advisory reflects Gulf state concerns over shipping security amid Iranian naval posturing. Domestic unrest in Iran's Khuzestan, evidenced by the truckers' strike, may limit regime bandwidth for external escalation. Israeli military leadership's public call for force expansion signals institutional preparation for multi-front conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: The clustering of Iranian missile and UAV events within hours — Haftkel, Omidiyeh, Isfahan, Khoy, Abadan, Saqqez — suggests a deliberate signaling campaign or integrated air defense drill rather than isolated incidents. The Shukin drone explosion in Lebanon aligns with Israeli targeting of Hezbollah logistics in the Nabatieh corridor. Trump's timeline (post-January 1) coincides with the U.S. presidential transition, creating a window of strategic ambiguity that Iran may exploit or seek to deter.
